source.symbol: ESR153 version-bump destination and Hg source selectors

text:
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

kind-dependencies:
    - release-beetmover-push-to-release

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    description: Release Promotion version bump/tag
    run-on-projects: []
    shipping-phase: ship
    worker-type: lando
    worker:
        implementation: scriptworker-lando
        repo-param-prefix: comm_
        lando-repo:
            by-project:
                comm-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
                comm-release: thunderbird-desktop-release
                comm-esr153: thunderbird-desktop-esr153
                try-comm-central:
                    by-release-type:
                        beta: staging-thunderbird-beta
                        release: staging-thunderbird-release
                        esr153: staging-thunderbird-esr153
                        default: ""
                default: ""
        actions:
            - tag:
                  types: ["release"]

                  # Used to map hg revisions to the git revisions needed by scriptworker-lando
                  hg-repo-url:
                      by-project:
                          comm-beta: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-beta
                          comm-release: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-release
                          comm-esr153: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-esr153
                          try-comm-central: https://hg.mozilla.org/try-comm-central
                          default: ""
            - version-bump:
                  bump-files:
                      by-release-type:
                          default: ["mail/config/version_display.txt"]
                          release|esr.*:
                              - "mail/config/version.txt"
                              - "mail/config/version_display.txt"

tasks:
    thunderbird:
        name: thunderbird-version-bump
        shipping-product: thunderbird
        treeherder:
            platform: thunderbird-release/opt
            symbol: Rel(VerBump)
            tier: 1
            kind: build
title: ESR153 version-bump destination and Hg source selectors
